description: This file 'DataElement.cpp' implements the 'DataElement' class and the 'LinkedDataElement' class. It provides functionality for calculating CRC32 checksums, managing buffer data with boundary handling, and copying data between linked data elements within a larger data structure. The file includes static lookup tables for CRC, buffer access methods, and a copy method for linked data elements.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with buffer management and CRC computation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A linked list node for handling segments of data, supporting buffer read/write and copying between nodes.

methods.name: DataElement::CRC32
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum over a specified portion of the buffer.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::GetBuffer
methods.description: Reads a segment of data from the linked data element buffer, handling boundary crossing.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::SetBuffer
methods.description: Writes a segment of data into the linked data element buffer, handling boundary crossing.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another linked data element into this one, starting at a given offset.
